name: Reporting Settings Shell
summary: Reporting settings now expose a card-based recipient editor that manages module-specific To and CC email recipients used by the Reporting preview dialog.

userActions: Open Reporting recipient settings from the settings shell
Edit or delete existing To and CC recipients
Maintain the recipient lists used by the Reporting preview dialog
preserveRules: Keep Reporting recipients stored separately from Volvo recipients
Keep recipients presented as cards rather than a grid
acceptanceCriteria: Reporting settings open the recipient editor from a card-based shell
Users can add, edit, and delete Reporting To and CC recipients
Metadata reflects the live recipient-maintenance surfaces
validationHints: Confirm the Reporting settings shell opens the recipient editor from its card
Confirm recipient cards can be added, edited, and deleted without using a data table
Confirm Reporting recipient changes are persisted and available to preview copy actions
